subject.title: feat(android): approve, reject, and remove device pairings from the phone

question: Should Android expose pairing administration only to already full-access/admin sessions while the limited mobile bootstrap profile remains unchanged, once the consent and self-removal safeguards are fixed?
rationale: The branch deliberately leaves the limited-bootstrap scope decision open, and exposing pairing administration is a security-sensitive product capability rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Land a constrained pairing UI
options.body: Keep the limited bootstrap profile unchanged and accept the feature only for existing authorized sessions after repairing consent disclosure, self-removal, and real-device proof.

options.title: Defer mobile pairing administration
options.body: Retain CLI-only pairing administration until maintainers decide the intended mobile authorization and onboarding policy.

recommendation.title: Land a constrained pairing UI
recommendation.body: Keep the limited bootstrap profile unchanged and accept the feature only for existing authorized sessions after repairing consent disclosure, self-removal, and real-device proof.
